name: Landbot
oneLiner: No-code chatbot builder for websites, WhatsApp and Messenger, with a visual flow editor and an AI Agent block for open-ended questions.
bestFor: Independent restaurants and small groups (especially in WhatsApp-heavy markets) that want to build their own reservation, FAQ, ordering or feedback bots without developers.

updates.text: Landbot 4 added an AI Agent block, an AI Copilot for building bots, Hybrid AI components (buttons and selectors inside AI conversations) and a two-way n8n integration; the OpenAI block was renamed AI Task.

features: Visual drag-and-drop flow builder, no code needed
Bots for web, WhatsApp Business and Facebook Messenger
AI Agent that answers open-ended questions from your content (paid plans)
Hybrid AI: buttons, selectors and autocomplete inside AI conversations
Ready-made templates, including a WhatsApp restaurant table reservation bot
Integrations with Google Sheets, Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks and CRMs
Conversational forms and surveys for feedback collection

pricing.text: Published plans: free Sandbox (100 chats/month), Starter about €40/month and Pro about €100/month; WhatsApp plans are priced separately (WhatsApp Pro reported at about €200/month) and Business from about €400/month. AI chats and extra chats are metered. Sources disagree on WhatsApp tiers; confirm on landbot.io/pricing.

notes: landbot.io could not be fetched; pricing figures come from Landbot's own pricing blog post and 2026 third-party reviews, which conflict on WhatsApp plan prices (€80 vs €160/€200). No restaurant or hospitality customer story found; named customers are from other industries (finance, real estate, events, communities). The restaurant reservation template is real (https://landbot.io/chabot-templates/restaurant-reservation). The current review's claim that restaurants 'take orders' and run the full guest journey on WhatsApp is a capability description, not a verified customer example. Reviewers note Landbot is closer to rule-based flows than fully conversational AI. Funding ~$10.2M per Owler; no 2026 corporate news found.
